issues.issue: Should the new evidence (photograph of notepad, passport, 2011 news article) be admitted under s.110(4) IRPA?
issues.applicant_position: Proposed new evidence is relevant and should be admitted, including the notepad photo, passport and kidnapping article.
issues.result_quote: I find that this evidence does not meet the test under subsection 110(4) of the IRPA.

issues.issue: Did the RPD err in its credibility findings (peripheral and Western-lens findings)?
issues.applicant_position: RPD findings were peripheral or made through a Western lens, and date errors were minor; the claim should be believed.
issues.result_quote: The Appellants have challenged this, and, in part, I agree with their arguments.

issues.issue: Do the appellants face a forward-facing section 96 or section 97 risk?
issues.applicant_position: Ex-husband remains angry and a threat; RPD failed to complete a section 96 analysis; well-founded fear established.
issues.result_quote: I find that they have not established a serious possibility of persecution or a section 97(1) risk, on a balance of probabilities, on a forward-facing basis.
